create_model_adapter: create a ChameleonModelAdapter instance with a transformer model and max sequence length
initialize_adapter_with_prompts: initialize the model adapter with a list of prompt token sequences to set up cache
check_alignment_support: check if the model adapter supports a given prompt alignment strategy like AlignPromptLeft
run_inference_forward_pass: run the model adapter on input tokens to get logits for the first pass
run_inference_decode_step: run the model adapter on single token inputs for autoregressive decoding after the first pass
